title: Propose a change to an existing workflow
prompt: Our Code Review workflow should also check dependencies for known vulnerabilities, in parallel with the other reviews, and the final report must include that section. Change it for me.
setup: The server has the Code Review template imported and published (generatorai workflow import --template code-review --publish, done by a person).

shape: the agent calls list_workflows and describe_workflow on Code Review before drafting
the existing stage keys are kept unchanged; one new read-only stage (for example dependency_review) is added in parallel with the other reviews
the report stage gets an edge from the new stage and its prompt mentions the new section
the draft is created with replacesWorkflowId set to the Code Review workflow id

pass: the plan is shown to the user before the draft is created
the draft replaces the existing workflow (replacesWorkflowId); the agent does not publish it
no forbidden fields (as in eval 01); no existing stage key renamed
